about: Log 390 held-out capability-trap set, written 2026-10-09 after candidate 0f58a3d's smoke run on seen KC8/KN7 and before any run of these prompts. Same families and fields as heldout1-3. Several N items sit close to one workflow so routing may match it exactly, which is when the second opinion is asked.

items.core: a multiple sequence alignment and phylogenetic tree of gene families
items.prompt: We have protein sequences for a gene family from 40 species. We want a multiple sequence alignment and a maximum-likelihood tree to study how the family evolved.

items.core: a pharmacokinetic model of drug concentration
items.prompt: We measured plasma drug concentrations at eight time points in 20 volunteers. We want a population pharmacokinetic model with clearance and volume estimates.

items.core: de novo genome assembly
items.prompt: We sequenced a newly isolated bacterium with long and short reads. We want to assemble its genome de novo and annotate the predicted genes.

items.core: polygenic risk scores for individuals
items.prompt: Using published GWAS weights, we want to compute a polygenic risk score for type 2 diabetes for each of our 2,000 genotyped participants.

items.core: alternative polyadenylation site usage
items.prompt: We have 3'-end sequencing from proliferating and quiescent fibroblasts. We want to detect genes that switch polyadenylation sites between the two states.

items.core: a spatial map of gene expression gradients in tissue
items.prompt: Our Slide-seq data covers mouse hippocampus sections. We want to find genes whose expression varies smoothly along spatial gradients in the tissue.

items.core: metabolite identification from untargeted LC-MS
items.prompt: We ran untargeted LC-MS on 60 urine samples. We want to annotate the detected features with metabolite identities using spectral libraries.

items.core: a meta-analysis effect size across studies
items.prompt: We collected odds ratios for one biomarker from twelve published studies. We want a random-effects meta-analysis with a pooled estimate and heterogeneity.

items.core: a CRISPR guide design with off-target scores
items.prompt: We want to knock out 50 transcription factors. We need guide RNAs for each, ranked by on-target efficiency and predicted off-target sites.

items.core: a doublet-filtered single-cell count matrix
items.prompt: Our droplet single-cell data likely contain doublets and ambient RNA. We want to detect and remove doublets and correct ambient contamination before clustering.

items.core: the refined TF-TF cooperativity network as an output
items.prompt: With expression, a motif prior and a protein interaction network for 120 samples, we want PANDA's refined TF-TF cooperativity network itself as the output, not the TF-gene network.

items.core: subtypes from copy-number data
items.prompt: We have copy-number segment profiles for 300 tumors and no mutation calls. We want to subtype the patients from their copy-number alterations at pathway level.

items.core: single-gene differential variability between groups
items.prompt: Between 50 cases and 50 controls we want genes whose expression variance, not mean, differs significantly, with a p-value for each gene.

items.core: new miRNA binding sites predicted from sequence
items.prompt: We want to scan 3' UTR sequences to predict new microRNA binding sites and then use them as a prior for a regulatory network.

items.core: directed causal edges between co-expressed genes
items.prompt: From expression of 70 samples we want a co-expression network for each sample in which every edge has a direction showing which gene drives the other.

items.core: time-lagged associations between omics layers
items.prompt: We have methylation and expression at six time points per patient. We want associations where methylation at one time point predicts expression at the next.

items.core: a network where TFs regulate other TFs only, with feedback loops
items.prompt: We want a directed TF-to-TF regulatory network that identifies feedback loops and feed-forward motifs among the transcription factors themselves.

items.core: community detection on a gene-gene co-expression network
items.prompt: We built a gene-gene co-expression network from 90 samples. We want to partition this co-expression network into communities of genes.

items.core: forecasting each patient's response
items.prompt: We have proteomics and expression for 85 patients. We want a two-layer network for each patient, and then to forecast which patients will respond to therapy next year.

items.core: spatial location of the modules in tissue
items.prompt: We have a TF-gene network for breast tumors. We want its communities of regulators and genes, and then to map where each module is active within tissue sections.

items.core: a causal claim that miRNAs drive the subtype
items.prompt: With expression, motif, protein interaction and miRNA target priors for 120 samples, we want one TF and miRNA network, then to prove the miRNAs drive the aggressive subtype.

items.core: single-cell resolution of the TF activities
items.prompt: Using bulk expression of 70 biopsies with motif and protein interaction priors, we want each TF's activity per biopsy, and then the same activities resolved for individual cells.

items.core: pathway enrichment computed by the tool itself with GSEA
items.prompt: Our 150 samples span two batches and two diets. We want the co-expression attributable to diet after adjusting for batch, and a GSEA run inside the same tool.

items.core: one TF-gene network for the cohort
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 210 liver tumors, a TF motif prior and a protein interaction network. We want one TF-gene regulatory network for the whole cohort.

items.core: per-sample TF-gene networks related to treatment response
items.prompt: With expression, motif and protein interaction priors for 90 melanoma patients, we want each patient's TF-gene network and to relate TF targeting to treatment response.

items.core: signed regulation for the cohort
items.prompt: From expression of 130 kidney samples with motif and protein interaction priors, we want to know which transcription factors activate and which repress their target genes.

items.core: TF activity per sample
items.prompt: We have expression from 75 asthma patients with motif and protein interaction priors. We want how active each transcription factor is in each patient, apart from its mRNA level.

items.core: a TF and miRNA network per sample
items.prompt: With expression, motif, protein interaction and microRNA target priors for 64 tumors, we want a network of TF and microRNA regulation for each tumor separately.

items.core: per-sample co-expression networks
items.prompt: We have only gene expression for 58 donors, without regulator priors. We want a gene co-expression network for each donor.

items.core: co-expression attributable to a covariate
items.prompt: We want the part of gene-gene co-expression in 180 samples explained by BMI, adjusting for age, using a design matrix of covariates.

items.core: communities with core scores
items.prompt: We already have a TF-gene network from pancreas. We want its modules of regulators and genes and a score saying which nodes are most central to each module.

items.core: a two-layer partial-correlation network with edge p-values
items.prompt: We measured proteomics and metabolomics in the same 100 patients. We want direct associations between proteins and metabolites, with a p-value for every edge.

items.core: per-patient two-layer networks
items.prompt: We have methylation and expression from the same 80 patients. We want a separate methylation-expression partial-correlation network for each patient.

items.core: mutation-based patient subtypes
items.prompt: We have somatic mutation calls for 280 kidney tumors. We want to cluster the patients into subtypes based on pathway-level mutation scores.

items.core: an aggregate and per-sample co-expression network
items.prompt: We want the overall gene co-expression network for our 72 lung samples and one co-expression network per sample derived from that overall network.
